new_defect_found.name: Traffic measurement is disconnected in production
new_defect_found.evidence: 78 deployed site pages POST their view beacon to a relative '/api/page-view', which on the GitHub Pages host resolves to https://galaxyaek7-del.github.io/api/page-view and returns HTTP 404. The handler's .catch(()=>{}) swallows the failure. Only 25 view rows exist in data/affiliate_page_views.jsonl, all dated 2026-08-09 (local testing), none since.
new_defect_found.consequence: This is the mechanical reason 'qualified visits' has read UNKNOWN for many cycles. The factory cannot currently observe its own traffic, so no conversion work can be measured.
new_defect_found.not_fixed_and_why: A working receiver requires publicly hosting the Express server. GitHub Pages is static-only. That is an infrastructure/hosting/cost decision, not a code fix, and was not undertaken autonomously.
